calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = true THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as staff_purchases
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as garden_sku_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.sku) as skus_in_fact_table
FROM dim_product_old dpo
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON dpo.sku = dp.sku
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON dp.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'

SELECT COUNT(*) as old_garden_skus
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT sku
  FROM dim_product_old
  WHERE category = 'Garden'
) t

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(fr.refund_net) as returns_net
FROM fact_return_line fr
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fr.return_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fr.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(fr.refund_net), 0), 2) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line fr ON f.sales_line_id = fr.sales_line_id AND d.fiscal_year = (SELECT fiscal_year FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date = fr.return_date)
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

WITH garden_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
  WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
),
garden_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(fr.refund_net) as total_returns
  FROM fact_return_line fr
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fr.return_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fr.product_key = dp.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
  WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  s.fiscal_year,
  s.fiscal_period,
  (s.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0)) as net_sales
FROM garden_sales s
LEFT JOIN garden_returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY s.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  'Sales' as data_source,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  MIN(f.net_amount) as min_amount,
  MAX(f.net_amount) as max_amount
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
WHERE dpo.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
